title: Curiosity is a civic practice.
intro: Athenae Initiative is a nonprofit organization dedicated to making a humanities education more accessible, approachable, and engaging for people of all ages and backgrounds. In a time where the value of learning is often measured against profit, productivity and career advancement, Athenae Initiative engages in reaffirming the importance of critical thought, creativity, and human expression in a world that too often treats them as secondary.
body:
## What we believe

A healthy public life depends on access to ideas and on the freedom to examine them together.

## How we work

Through student-led publications, podcasts, live “speakers-corner” debates and community events, Athenae Initiative aims to make the humanities approachable, enjoyable, and most importantly - open to all.
